ax_001_v2_defense_like_evaluation.ax_001_v2_overall_verdict: FAIL_DEFENSE_LIKE — Hedge does not produce defense-like regime asymmetry. CRISIS regime SR DETERIORATES from S1 baseline +0.018 to M4+FH -0.160. MDD improvement post-cost (-1.75pp) below spec target -3pp. CAUTION regime is the only regime where hedge adds value (+0.22 SR vs S1) but CRISIS deterioration dominates AX-001 v2 conditional evaluation.
